name: softicon-mega-menu
description: Mega menu block for the Navigation block in block themes

scripts.zip:
rm -f softicon-mega-menu.zip && printf '→ Building block
' && (npm run -s build >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run build) && printf '→ Translations
' && (npm run -s i18n-pot >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run i18n-pot) && npm run -s find-ds && printf '→ Zipping
' && cd .. && zip -rq softicon-mega-menu/softicon-mega-menu.zip softicon-mega-menu/softicon-mega-menu.php softicon-mega-menu/index.php softicon-mega-menu/includes softicon-mega-menu/src softicon-mega-menu/build softicon-mega-menu/languages softicon-mega-menu/readme.txt softicon-mega-menu/package.json softicon-mega-menu/webpack.config.js -x '*/.DS_Store' '*.map'
scripts.postzip:
printf '
✔ Zip ready: %s
  %s files, %s

' "$PWD/softicon-mega-menu.zip" "$(unzip -l softicon-mega-menu.zip | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}')" "$(du -h softicon-mega-menu.zip | cut -f1 | tr -d ' ')"
scripts.bundle: npm run lint && npm run zip
